You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Landon Stein. Mortician. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Contract Quill, Beat-up Paperback, Dispatcher's headset, Photo album, Brass Locket. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last nigh
